questions.question: In a certain code language, 'LABOUR' is written as 'XZSECM' and ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘JJRLCH’. How will 'EARNED' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​Number according to the position of letter within the word is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

 
• First letter → (+1) is added
 
• Second letter → (+2) is added
 
• Third letter → (+3) is added
 
• Fourth letter → (+4) is added
 
• Fifth letter → (+5) is added
 
• Sixth letter → (+6) is added

​So,

 
• 'LABOUR' is written as 'XZSECM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a99eafdc6b3f3d172588e35902fbdf65bd43d7b05c95d21f93e878e7d3710f.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘JJRLCH’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce8e0532a84183cd526dcb4ee4e7f01434314429c2f5666265701b588924aa8e.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'EARNED' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc1ef8373608ae0679b60f568667595cb6db0916cb65dfa61b9d957d0f39592c.png] 

Hence, "**JJRUCF**" is the correct answer.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ca559a12e7bcad6cdba1cf8a23c288b092e5218296e5b61394d53ee4de19085.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

First, arrange in alphabetical order.

BOOK is in alphabetical order is BKOO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24f70a2dfad187b7ef612cef53b8db757e228b3acc5b5b1a570b5a5acdda2fb4.png] 

Similarly,

COPY is already arranged in alphabetical order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09effcbb26cb647bcbfa91dbcb812651f16fa051a3fc3e815f9fb544204685b2.png] 

Hence,** "DQSC"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

If the word BOOK is not arranged then the coded answer of COPY would be DMSG but it is not in the option, So in exam, we need to think differently about its logic rather than considering it as a wrong question.

A new pattern is observed in the recent examination where letters are arranged in alphabetical order or reverse alphabetical order first then coding-decoding shifting takes place.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘NORMAL’ is written as ‘DIPKRO’ and ‘SOUND’ is written as ‘GKRPX’. How will ‘CLUSTER’ be written in that language?
